records.region: Northern Ontario and Manitoba coast, Canada; partial Black Duck River middle/lower corridor and Hudson Bay outlet, with the southern initial feeder unresolved.
records.material_pending_reason: The selected initial feeder and its connection south of56°N are not established by sufficiently detailed original cartography. The regional Hosea Lake/Black Duck context cannot establish the selected lake or channel itinerary.
records.geographic_disambiguation: Original OGS P.3626 and P.3625 cartography supports the Black Duck River corridor from the latitude-56-degree map seam northward to Hudson Bay, including its meandering valley, lowland wetland setting and branched coastal outlet. The actual selected headward interval south of that seam remains unsupported by sufficiently detailed primary cartography. The retained OGS northern index supplies regional context, including Hosea Lake, but does not establish that the selected initial feeder passes through that lake or demonstrate its connection to the detailed mapped corridor. This is a material-source gap, not a completed naming-scope hold.
records.completion_scope: Original OGS P.3626 and P.3625 cartography supports the Black Duck River corridor from the latitude-56-degree map seam northward to Hudson Bay, including its meandering valley, lowland wetland setting and branched coastal outlet. The actual selected headward interval south of that seam remains unsupported by sufficiently detailed primary cartography. component_scope_limits: The original detailed maps identify Black Duck River on the selected middle/lower corridor and at its coastal terminal. They do not cover the initial selected southern headward route. The candidate is therefore a receiving-component identity, not an established representative name for the full selected feature. Nearby lake and creek labels are not transferred to the mainstem, and the downstream river name is not assigned to unseen headwater reaches.

material_pending_components.gap: Actual selected initial headward and connector interval south of 56 degrees north.
material_pending_components.why_material: The selected southern branch and its connection to the detailed mapped Black Duck corridor are not independently demonstrated. A regional basin label, Hosea Lake association or modeled connectivity cannot substitute for that evidence.
material_pending_components.needed: Distinct permitted primary cartography or bounded primary original material that demonstrates this initial feeder and connector at ordinary corridor scale.
material_pending_components.not_required: Exact bank, vertex, surveyed source point or individual small-branch naming.

records.completion_scope: All selected FID 13945 parts were considered at generalized corridor/component scale. Most of the chosen line is demonstrably inside one salt flat. A genuine headward/connector-evidence gap prevents both completed representative identity and completed naming-scope hold. No additional exact bank, vertex or mouth-point agreement is required.
records.region: Bolivia; southern local-drainage approach and long traversal of Salar de Uyuni, with the headward opening and Catuyuma Pampa connector unresolved.
records.material_pending_reason: The selected southern opening lies beyond the inspected detailed sheet, and local drainage near Cuye/Catuyuma Pampa does not establish the complete chosen connector into Salar de Uyuni. The independently mapped salt-flat traversal and terminal do not close these headward gaps.
records.geographic_disambiguation: Material pending. Independent original mapping establishes a southern local-drainage setting, extensive Salar de Uyuni traversal and an interior-salar terminal. The selected headward opening and its continuation across Catuyuma Pampa to the salar are not fully established. No representative river hydronym is supported; Salar de Uyuni is the mapped receiving terrain, not an accepted river name.

component_scope_limits: Do not name the modeled cross-salar continuation after a nearby quebrada, a perimeter lake, Río Grande de Lípez, or the endorheic basin as a whole.
The source maps distinguish Salar de Uyuni from western Empexa and southern La Laguna/Laguani settings; no selected inter-salar connection to those separate basins is established.
Unknown local or representative names remain null.
No current perennial flow, exact mouth coordinate, formal name registration or official river length is inferred.

material_pending_components.scope: Southern opening before entry into the mapped Yonza valley
material_pending_components.required_evidence: Permitted primary original cartography or bounded first-party field evidence covering this opening and its linkage to the valley.

material_pending_components.scope: Local quebrada drainage at Cuye/Catuyuma Pampa to the southern Uyuni salt-flat margin
material_pending_components.required_evidence: Permitted original evidence establishing the selected drainage connection across the plain; broad basin or salar membership alone is insufficient.

records.completion_scope: Full geographic correspondence of the selected Inland Ice opening, headward loop, complete ice/nunatak connectors, southward turn and inner Geologfjord terminal at ordinary generalized corridor scale. No representative natural-river identity, exact current ice front or surveyed river mouth is established.
records.region: East Greenland; Inland Ice–Wilkins/Eyvind Fjeld–Waltershausen-adjacent ice corridor, then Nunatakgletscher and inner Geologfjord.
records.candidate_name_role: No supported representative natural-river identity; geographic glacier, nunatak, land and fjord names are contextual only.
records.naming_scope_hold_reason: Overlapping original maps account for the Inland Ice opening and complete ice/nunatak/glacier corridor through the inner Geologfjord ending. The mapped glaciers, nunataks, lands and fjord do not establish a representative natural-river identity for the artificial whole-route group.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The selected ending is the inner Geologfjord/Nunatakgletscher corridor. It is not assigned to the separately mapped Waltershausen Gletscher continuation into Nordfjord, or to the farther-west Gerard De Geer Gletscher–Isfjord corridor. Neighboring Granitsø is not assigned as a selected through-lake passage.

records.supported_name_scope: Rowley River is directly supported along the mapped valley below Maino Lake and below Separation Lake to Steensby Inlet. Maino and Separation are distinct lake labels. No whole-feature scalar name or uniform tributary/lake-passage hydronym is established, and the upper selected corridor remains materially uninspected.
records.region: Baffin Island, Nunavut, Canada; Rowley River downstream of the western Maino Lake passage, through Separation Lake to Steensby Inlet, with eastern upper-route gaps.
records.material_pending_reason: Actual original-map correspondence remains missing for the eastern headwater/upper river corridor, its material junctions and the northeastern approach into Maino Lake. The mapped western Maino outlet, Rowley middle/lower course and real Steensby terminal do not close that upper geographic gap.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The inspected downstream corridor is Rowley River, including the Separation Lake passage and terminal on Steensby Inlet. The eastern headward route and Maino entrance still lack allowed original-map correspondence, so the single primary outcome is source-material pending rather than completed representative identity or a completed scope hold.
records.completion_scope: The inspected downstream corridor is Rowley River, including the Separation Lake passage and terminal on Steensby Inlet. The eastern headward route and Maino entrance still lack allowed original-map correspondence, so the single primary outcome is source-material pending rather than completed representative identity or a completed scope hold.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. Keep base records, scope clauses, region qualifiers and assessment histories unchanged. Apply explicit status-list changes. Subtract all recorded IDs from the exact eligible initial inventory to recover unrecorded targets; pending IDs remain recorded but are not completed source reviews.
publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
